title: Algorithm: Exponential Backoff Network Retry
subtitle: Resilient Microservice Communication
description: Simulate retry backoff intervals across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
delay = 1
attempt = 1
# Stage 1: Backoff retry loop

challenges.title: Stage 1: Double Wait Intervals
challenges.description: While <hlt>attempt <= 3:</hlt> print <hlt>delay</hlt>, multiply <hlt>delay = delay * 2</hlt>, and increment <hlt>attempt = attempt + 1</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
delay = 1
attempt = 1
# Stage 1: Backoff retry loop
while attempt <= 3:
    print(delay)
    delay = delay * 2
    attempt = attempt + 1

challenges.title: Stage 2: Max Cap Guard
challenges.description: Run 5 attempts with delay capped at max 8 seconds using <hlt>min(delay * 2, 8)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
delay = 1
attempt = 1
# Stage 2: Capped backoff
while attempt <= 5:
    print(delay)
    delay = min(delay * 2, 8)
    attempt = attempt + 1
